【绝对力量】：当本类型植物造成的总伤害为全场最高时，每次攻击额外造成30%原伤害的真实伤害=[Absolute Power]: When the total damage caused by this type of plant is the highest in the field, each attack will cause an additional 30% of the original damage as true damage.
【爽快射击】：植物射击50次后（投手需要的次数减半），接下来的1秒内获得无限射速=[Refreshing Shooting]: After shooting the plant 50 times (the number of times required by the shooter is halved), you will gain unlimited fire rate in the next 1 second.
【生命偷取】：植物获得1%生命偷取，作用于全场血量百分比最低的植物=[Life Steal]: Plants gain 1% life steal, which affects the plant with the lowest health percentage in the field.
【过载】：僵尸一段时间没有受到攻击后，下次受到的伤害大幅增加=[Overload]: After a zombie has not been attacked for a period of time, the damage it receives next time will be greatly increased.

Excessive accumulation of bullets may cause the game to freeze. New performance optimization mechanism: When the number of Emperor-type bullets on the field reaches the upper limit, new bullets will no longer be generated, and its damage will be superimposed on the next bullet of this plant (the damage will not be lost). The smaller the upper limit, the smoother and higher the damage of a single bullet. The larger the upper limit, the closer to the original game experience.

● 第一次做关卡=● First time doing a level
滚轮或拖动右侧滚动条阅读  ·  Esc关闭  ·  阅读指南不会修改关卡=Scroll or drag the right scroll bar to read · Esc to close · Reading the guide will not modify the level
第一次做关卡=First time doing a level
保存、试玩与排错=Save, play and troubleshoot
这次增加了什么=What was added this time
字符串、列表与对象=Strings, lists and objects
新增战斗规则的使用边界=Added usage boundaries for new combat rules
<b>先做一关能正常游玩的普通关，再加特殊规则。</b>\n\n1. 在基础设置填写关卡名称、编号，选择地图，设置初始阳光和总波数。当前波数输入范围是10～100；先用10波试做。\n2. 在“设置出怪”中选择可出现的僵尸，再到逐波出怪页面安排想固定生成的敌人。\n3. 在卡牌页面配置玩家能使用的植物和卡槽，修改价格、冷却后使用该页的保存修改功能。\n4. 设置胜利方式。第一次制作先使用普通胜利，暂时少开特殊模式。\n5. 点击底部“保存并生成关卡”，再开始游戏检查是否能种植、出怪和正常结束。\n6. 基础关卡正常后，再到事件页添加提示、定时阳光、奖励选择等规则。\n\n<b>事件节点不是必填项</b>\n普通关卡可以不添加节点。需要“什么时候发生什么事”时，再使用事件规则。\n\n<b>推荐第一次练习</b>\n在事件页点“添加规则模板”，选择“每5秒获得阳光”。选中节点查看说明、改数量，保存后试玩。=<b>First make a normal level that can be played normally, and then add special rules.</b>\n\n1. Fill in the level name and number in the basic settings, select the map, and set the initial sunlight and total number of waves. The current wave number input range is 10~100; try using 10 waves first. 2. Select the zombies that can appear in "Set up monsters", and then go to the wave-by-wave monsters page to arrange the enemies you want to permanently generate. 3. Configure the plants and card slots that players can use on the card page, modify the price and cool down and use the save modification function on this page. 4. Set up ways to win. For the first time making, use the normal victory first, and don’t turn on the special mode for the time being. 5. Click "Save and Generate Level" at the bottom, then start the game to check whether it can be planted, monsters spawned, and ends normally. 6. After the basic level is normal, go to the event page to add rules such as prompts, scheduled sunshine, and reward selection.\n\n<b>Event node is not required</b>\nOrdinary levels do not need to add nodes. Use event rules when you need "what happens when".\n\n<b>Recommended for first time practice</b>\nClick "Add Rule Template" on the event page and select "Get sunlight every 5 seconds". Select the node to view the description, change the quantity, save and try it out.
● 地图、规则与胜负=● Maps, rules and victory or defeat
<b>地图决定场地，规则决定玩法。</b>\n\n基础页：关卡名、编号、地图、初始阳光和总波数。\n模式页：禁用正常出怪、自然阳光、小推车，以及传送带、种子雨、我是僵尸等特殊玩法。\n胜利页：选择普通胜利或我是僵尸胜利。\n\n<b>第一次制作的建议</b>\n先只调整初始阳光和出怪。每增加一个模式开关就试玩一次，方便确定哪个设置改变了玩法。\n“禁正常出怪”会让通常的波次出怪停止；如果打开，需要自行安排生成敌人的机制。没有敌人时，先检查这里。\n不建议初次制作就同时开启大量模式。界面没有自动保证所有组合都能配合。\n\n<b>胜负节点</b>\n特殊任务可以用“令游戏胜利/结束”节点主动结算，但要确保只在任务真正完成或失败时触发。普通关卡先用原有胜负规则。=<b>The map determines the venue, and the rules determine the gameplay.</b>\n\nBasic page: level name, number, map, initial sunlight and total number of waves. Mode page: Disable normal monster spawning, natural sunlight, carts, and special gameplay such as conveyor belt, seed rain, and I am a zombie. Victory Page: Choose Normal Victory or iZombie Victory.\n\n<b>Advice for first time makers</b>\nFirst, only adjust the initial sunlight and monster spawning. Play with each additional mode switch to determine which setting changes gameplay. "Disable normal monster spawning" will stop normal waves of monster spawning; if turned on, you need to arrange the mechanism for generating enemies by yourself. When there are no enemies, check here first. It is not recommended to open a large number of modes at the same time for the first time. The interface does not automatically guarantee that all combinations will work.\n\n<b>Victory or defeat node</b>\nSpecial tasks can be actively resolved using the "Make Game Victory/End" node, but be sure to only trigger when the task is actually completed or failed. For ordinary levels, the original winning and losing rules will be used first.
